name: Apache + ModSecurity
summary: Reads the Apache access.log and error.log and the ModSecurity audit log, joins the three into one event per request (UNIQUE_ID) and tells what ModSecurity already blocked from what reached the application.

manual_only.label: Only the sources below
manual_only.help: Do not discover the logs from the Apache configuration: read only the sources listed below.

sources.label: Sources added by hand
sources.help: Logs to read besides the discovered ones (or instead of them, with the option above). Absolute paths.

config_file.label: Apache configuration file
config_file.help: Empty: found automatically (/etc/apache2/apache2.conf on Debian, /etc/apache2/httpd.conf on Alpine).

discovery_interval_seconds.label: Discovery interval (seconds)
discovery_interval_seconds.help: How often the Apache configuration is read again to find new vhosts and logs.

anomaly_threshold.label: Blocking threshold of ModSecurity
anomaly_threshold.help: 0: read from the CRS configuration (tx.inbound_anomaly_score_threshold), 5 if it is not there.

learning_days.label: Learning days for new PHP files
learning_days.help: During the first days a PHP file never seen before is not reported as new (rule apache-webshell).
